description: This Java class defines a command for retrieving a specific feature's properties within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for constructing instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing resource paths, with a focus on a feature identified by feature ID on a specific thing.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureProperties
classes.description: A final immutable class representing the command to retrieve properties of a specific feature on a thing, providing construction and parsing methods, resource path computation, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveFeatureProperties command with given ThingId, feature ID, optional selected fields, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a RetrieveFeatureProperties command instance.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an optional collection of specific fields to retrieve within the feature's properties.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing entity associated with the command.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature to which this command pertains.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the feature's properties resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command, including thing ID, feature ID, and optional selected fields.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with the specified Ditto headers.
